name: Live catalogue loads only purchasable products
description: Manual QA: verify the storefront uses active Supabase products and does not offer unavailable stock for purchase.
steps: Open the PUASH homepage
Confirm live products and categories load
Check that out-of-stock products cannot be added to cart
Search for a product and apply a category filter
expected: Active products appear with current prices and stock. Out-of-stock items cannot be purchased. Search and category filtering return matching products.

name: Cart persists between storefront and product detail
description: Manual QA for the shared browser cart used by the homepage and product detail page.
steps: Open a live product detail page
Add an available quantity to cart
Return to the homepage and open the cart
Refresh the page and open the cart again
expected: The same product and quantity remain in the cart across navigation and refresh. Quantity cannot exceed the displayed available stock.

name: Checkout requires a signed-in customer and saved address
description: Manual QA of the customer checkout prerequisites.
steps: Add an active in-stock product to cart
Continue to checkout while signed out
Sign in or create a customer account
Save a delivery address in the account and return to checkout
expected: Signed-out customers are directed to the account page. Checkout proceeds only after a saved address is available and selected.

name: Server validates and places a Cash on Delivery order
description: Requires an explicitly designated test customer and a low-value test product. Do not run against real customer orders.
steps: Use a dedicated test customer and test product with sufficient stock
Place a Cash on Delivery order using a saved test address
Verify the order and its item rows in the test environment
Verify product stock decreases by the ordered quantity
expected: The database calculates price and delivery fee, validates ownership and stock, creates the order and item rows, and deducts stock transactionally. No client-supplied price is trusted.

name: Wishlist save and remove
description: Manual QA using a dedicated test customer.
steps: Sign in as the test customer
Save an active product to the wishlist
Open the account wishlist
Remove the saved product
expected: The saved product appears in the account wishlist and disappears after removal. Other customers' wishlist entries remain private.

name: Verified review is available only after delivery
description: Manual QA using a test order that has been marked delivered in a non-production test flow.
steps: Open a product before any delivered purchase and inspect the review form
Complete a test purchase and mark its order delivered in the test flow
Open the product detail page and submit a review
Edit the review and reload the page
expected: A customer without a delivered purchase cannot submit a review. A verified purchaser can create and edit one review for that product.

name: Order, shipping and return updates reach the customer
description: Manual QA with a dedicated test customer and test order; do not modify real customer orders.
steps: Place a test order
Update its status and shipping details in the test flow
Verify the customer account reflects the update
Submit a return request for an eligible delivered test order and update its status
expected: Customer order details and notifications reflect supported status, shipping and return changes without exposing another customer's records.

name: Customer data remains isolated by account
description: Security QA requiring two separate test customer accounts.
steps: Create two dedicated test customer accounts
Create an address, wishlist entry and test order for customer A
Sign in as customer B and inspect customer-facing account data
Verify customer B cannot read or modify customer A's records
expected: Each customer can access only their own private addresses, orders, wishlist and notifications. Public catalogue and reviews remain readable as intended.
